name: @novelai-image-mcp/docs
description: Sphinx documentation site for NovelAI Image MCP

scripts.build:zh: uv run sphinx-build -b html source/zh _build/zh/html -c source -D language=zh
scripts.build:ja: uv run sphinx-build -b html source/ja _build/ja/html -c source -D language=ja
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:zh && pnpm run build:ja
scripts.serve:zh: uv run sphinx-autobuild source/zh _build/zh/html -c source -D language=zh --open-browser
scripts.serve:ja: uv run sphinx-autobuild source/ja _build/ja/html -c source -D language=ja --open-browser
